assumptions.sentence: The C lowering tool (swdb lower, version 9) lowers the C++ proof unit to C that behaves the same; WP proves the C lowering, not the C++.
clang 22.1.8 parses the C++ proof unit correctly for the C lowering tool.
Frama-C/WP 33.0 generates only sound proof obligations for the C lowering under its memory model and the x86_64 machdep.
Z3 5.1.0 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
CVC5 1.2.1 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
Alt-Ergo 2.6.4 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.

The checked qualified destructor uses its original broad pointer/free domain, including receiver/backing overlap. It performs no buffer element load and adds no typed-int image restriction. It certifies this exact qualified subject only; generic caller composition and cross-view liveness discharge remain unsupported.

The pinned Why3 Boolean/map/ordered-arithmetic/absolute-value/division and Frama-C Qed/Cint arithmetic/conversion lemmas are trusted standard proof support; no project desired-result lemma is imported as a hypothesis.

obligations.statement: \forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) ==> Heap::typed_reads(h,r,o,8,8) && Heap::initialized_at(h,r,o) && Heap::pointer_at(h,r,o,b,bo)
\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) && (c == 0 || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)) ==> (b == 0 && bo == 0) || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)
\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer r,o,b,bo,s,c; Heap::well_formed(h) && t25_repr(h,r,o,b,bo,s,c) && (c == 0 || Heap::freeable(h,b,bo)) && c > 0 ==> !Heap::can_read(Heap::release(h,b),b,bo,4)

\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer dead,b,o; Heap::live(h,b) && b != dead ==> Heap::contents(Heap::release(h,dead),b,o) == Heap::contents(h,b,o) && (Heap::initialized_at(Heap::release(h,dead),b,o) <==> Heap::initialized_at(h,b,o))
\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer dead,b; b != dead ==> Heap::same_object(h,Heap::release(h,dead),b)

\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer b,n; Heap::well_formed(h) && Heap::freeable(h,b,0) && Heap::aligned(Heap::numerical_address(h,b),4) && 0 < n && 4*n <= Heap::bytes(h,b) ==> Heap::available(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)) && Heap::well_formed(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b))) && Heap::numerical_address(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)),Heap::fresh_id(h)) == Heap::numerical_address(h,b) && !Heap::can_read(Heap::allocate(Heap::release(h,b),n,Heap::numerical_address(h,b)),b,0,4)
\forall Heap::heap h; \forall integer b,o; Heap::can_read(h,b,o,4) && Heap::initialized_at(h,b,o) ==> Heap::live(h,b)
